title: The First Eid Morning
source_detail: Celebration and gratitude after Ramadan — completing the fast and giving thanks to Allah
description: A little child wakes up to the magical sounds and smells of Eid morning. New clothes, sweet treats, and hugs from everyone — a joyful celebration of gratitude and love.

pages.text: Little Layla fluttered her eyes open. The morning light felt different today, soft and golden. A happy feeling tickled her toes. It was Eid!
pages.illustration_prompt: A cozy bedroom scene. Layla, a young child (3-5), just waking up in bed, stretching slightly, a gentle smile on her face. Golden sunlight streams through a window, illuminating dust motes. Soft pink and warm gold hues. Vibrant digital painting with visible brushstrokes.

pages.text: From downstairs, she heard quiet, happy voices. And what was that delicious smell? Something sweet, like warm honey and spices, floated up the stairs.
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla's bedroom door slightly ajar, showing a glimpse of a sunlit hallway. Wisps of delicious-smelling steam (represented by soft, warm visual tendrils) float into her room. Her eyes are wide with curiosity and delight. Lush greens and warm golds in the hallway. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Layla remembered! Mama had laid out her special Eid dress. It was soft and sparkly, like a rainbow woven with threads of sunshine. She couldn't wait to put it on!
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla, still in bed, looking excitedly towards a chair where a beautiful, vibrant Eid outfit (a dress or kurta set) is carefully folded. The clothes sparkle gently. Color palette: soft pinks, sunset oranges, a hint of deep blue in the dress. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Mama helped Layla get dressed. Each button, each ribbon, felt extra special. 'Eid Mubarak, my little star,' Mama whispered, giving her a gentle hug.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mama (visible face, warm smile) gently helping Layla put on her Eid clothes. Layla is smiling. Warm, inviting atmosphere. Soft light. Rich, detailed background showing a part of the bedroom. Vibrant digital painting with warm golds.

pages.text: Soon, Papa and Mama and Layla stood together, ready for their special prayer. They thanked Allah for a wonderful Ramadan and for the joy of Eid.
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla, Mama, and Papa standing together on a prayer rug. Layla is observing her parents, who are in prayer posture (hands raised or folded). Their faces are visible, but the mood is reverent and peaceful. Soft golden light bathes the scene. A subtle, warm pattern on the prayer rug. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Layla felt so thankful in her heart. Thankful for her family, thankful for the sunny day, and thankful for all the love around her. Allah is so Merciful!
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Layla's face, looking upwards slightly with a serene, grateful expression. Her eyes are bright and expressive. Soft, warm light surrounds her, making her look peaceful and content. A gentle glow in the background, suggesting a feeling of warmth and love. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Downstairs, Grandma and Grandpa were waiting! 'Eid Mubarak!' they all cheered, their voices full of happiness. Layla ran to them for big, warm hugs.
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla running towards her grandparents who are sitting on a sofa or standing in a living room. All characters have warm, welcoming smiles. The room is decorated simply, perhaps with a vase of fresh flowers. Vibrant digital painting with lush greens and warm golds in the decor.

pages.text: Grandpa scooped her up, giving her a gentle squeeze. 'May Allah bless you, little one,' he murmured, his beard tickling her cheek.
pages.illustration_prompt: Grandpa holding Layla in a warm embrace, both smiling. Layla's head is resting near his shoulder, her eyes closed in contentment. A window in the background shows a bright, sunny outdoor scene. The colors are rich and inviting. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: On the dining table, a feast of sweet treats awaited! Cookies shaped like stars, honey cakes, and juicy dates. Layla's eyes sparkled.
pages.illustration_prompt: A beautifully arranged dining table laden with various Eid sweets: cookies, small cakes, dates. Layla is reaching out a small hand towards a plate, eyes wide with delight. Vibrant colors: sunset oranges, soft pinks, deep blues in the dishware. Rich, detailed background of the dining room. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Sharing yummy food made everyone smile even bigger. Each bite tasted like happiness, shared with the people she loved most.
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla sitting at the dining table with Mama and Papa, all enjoying the sweet treats. They are laughing softly, their faces full of joy. The scene is filled with warmth and togetherness. Soft light from a window illuminates them. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Later, they visited Auntie Huda and Uncle Omar's house. More 'Eid Mubarak' greetings and more friendly faces!
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla holding Mama's hand, walking up a path to a cheerful-looking house. Auntie Huda and Uncle Omar are at the doorway, waving with welcoming smiles. The garden is lush with vibrant flowers and greenery. Vibrant digital painting with a warm, inviting mood.

pages.text: Auntie Huda gave Layla a shiny, colorful envelope. Inside was a crisp, new note! 'Thank you, Auntie!' Layla chirped. This was Eidiyah!
pages.illustration_prompt: Auntie Huda gently handing Layla a small, decorative envelope. Layla's eyes are wide with surprise and happiness, looking at the envelope. The background shows a cozy living room. Warm golds and soft pinks dominate. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Layla played with her cousins in the garden. Chasing butterflies and giggling under the warm sun. Eid was full of so much fun!
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla and a couple of cousins (3-5 years old) playing in a vibrant garden. One child is chasing a colorful butterfly. Lush greens, bright flowers in soft pinks and sunset oranges, warm golden sunlight filtering through leaves. Children laughing. Vibrant digital painting with rich details.

pages.text: As the sun began to paint the sky with soft orange and purple, Layla felt a gentle calm. The day was ending, but the joyful feelings stayed.
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla sitting on a porch step or by a window, looking out at a beautiful sunset. The sky is painted with soft orange, pink, and deep blue hues. Her expression is peaceful and reflective. The mood is tranquil and magical. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: She thought about all the blessings: the new clothes, the sweet treats, the hugs, and the laughter. 'Alhamdulillah,' she whispered. Thank You, Allah.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Layla's face, eyes softly closed or looking down, a serene smile. A subtle, soft, warm light surrounds her, emphasizing her feeling of gratitude and contentment. The background is a soft, blurred wash of warm colors. Vibrant digital painting.

pages.text: Tucked snugly in bed, Layla felt safe and loved. What a truly wonderful Eid morning it had been. Sweet dreams, little star.
pages.illustration_prompt: Layla tucked into bed, eyes closed, a gentle smile. Her favorite stuffed animal is beside her. The room is dimly lit by a soft nightlight or moon glow filtering through the window. Deep blues and soft purples create a peaceful, calming atmosphere. Vibrant digital painting, bedtime-ready mood.
